title: 第9章 张家张擒虎第10章 张擒虎的狠辣
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: 深夜。
在月色的掩护下，数道身影快马加鞭的离开了青枫谷。
向着府城的方向疾驰而去。
风尘仆仆的几人终于是来到了升龙府城下。
作为一方郡治所在，升龙府的繁华程度，自然远非白河县可比。
其光是常住人口，就多达数百万。
看着眼前巍峨屹立的高耸城墙。
李行歌的眼中，一种名叫野心的东西，正在熊熊燃烧着。
“终有一天，这片大地，将由我来主宰。”
李行歌心中暗暗道。
一行人畅通无阻的入了府城。
走在车水马龙的街道上。
一旁，一袭青衫打扮的李延昭笑着道：“家主，奔波了两天了，想必大家也累了，明天拍卖会才开始，我等不如先找家酒楼吃个饭再休息一晚上。”
李行歌看了一眼疲累的众人，然后点了点头。
在李延昭的带领下，众人驻足于一家名叫“绿柳楼”
的酒楼前。
李延昭笑着介绍道：“家主，这绿柳楼的药膳味道在升龙府可是一绝！”
“那便试试吧。”
其实到了他这个境界，普通的药膳已经对他没有作用了。
但满足一下口腹之欲，还是有必要的。
气血境修士，可还没有辟谷的能力。
刚走到门口。
迎客的店小二便带着谄媚的笑容小步跑了过来：“几位客官，吃饭还是住宿？”
“吃饭，准备一间雅间，把你们这的招牌菜都上一份。”
身旁的李延昭答道。
看了一眼气势不凡的众人。
店小二的腰弯的越低了，态度愈发恭敬：“几位客官请跟我来，里面请。”
说完，伸手在前引路。
众人跟上。
很快，店小二便将李行歌几人安置在了一间雅间。
“几位客官稍等，小的已经吩咐后厨去做了，饭菜马上好，小的就在外面候着，若有吩咐，唤小的一声便好。”
说完，转身退了出去，顺带掩上了房门。
李行歌和李延昭相继落座。
几名护卫则是恭敬的侍立在一旁。
没让李行歌等太久，约莫半刻钟......
散发着独特香味的药膳便被小厮端了上来。
“白玉灵芝羹！”
“盘龙鳝！”
content_en:
late at night.
Under the cover of the moonlight, several figures left the Green Maple Valley at high speed.
He galloped towards Fucheng.
Two days later...
The few people who were tired of the journey finally arrived at the gate of Shenglong Mansion.
As the seat of a county, the prosperity of Shenglong Mansion is naturally far beyond that of Baihe County.
Its permanent population alone is in the millions.
Looking at the towering city wall in front of me.
In Li Xingge's eyes, something called ambition was burning.
"One day, this land will be dominated by me."
Li Xingge thought to himself.
The group of people entered Fucheng unimpeded.
Walking on a busy street.
On the side, Li Yanzhao, who was dressed in a green shirt, said with a smile: "Master, I have been running around for two days. Everyone must be tired. The auction will only start tomorrow. I might as well find a restaurant to have a meal first and then rest for the night."
Li Xingge glanced at the tired people and nodded.
Soon...
Under the leadership of Li Yanzhao, everyone stopped at a restaurant called "Green Willow House"
in front of the restaurant.
Li Yanzhao introduced with a smile: "Master, the medicinal taste of Luliulou is the best in Shenglong Mansion!"
"Then let's try it."
In fact, when he reached this state, ordinary medicinal diet had no effect on him.
But it is still necessary to satisfy the appetite.
The Qi and Blood Realm monks do not yet have the ability to live without grain.
Just walked to the door.
The waiter who greeted the guests trotted over with a flattering smile: "Guests, do you want to eat or stay?"
"For dinner, prepare a private room and serve all your signature dishes."
Li Yanzhao next to him replied.
He glanced at the impressive crowd.
The waiter stooped lower and his attitude became more respectful: "Please come with me, gentlemen. Please come inside."
After saying that, he stretched out his hand to lead the way.
Everyone follows.
Soon, the waiter placed Li Xingge and others in a private room.
"Guests, please wait a moment. The younger one has already ordered the chef to prepare the food. The food will be ready soon. The younger one is waiting outside. If you have any orders, just call the younger one."
After saying that, he turned around and retreated, closing the door behind him.
Li Xingge and Li Yanzhao took their seats one after another.
Several guards stood by respectfully.
Li Xingge was not kept waiting for too long, only about half a quarter of an hour...
The medicinal food exuding a unique fragrance was brought up by the waiter.
"White Jade Ganoderma Soup!"
"Panlong eel!"
